records.issue: An investor-owned utility scope statement must not be generalized to all electricity cooperatives.
Plan-year retail sales use specified adjustments rather than gross local electricity generation.
RECs represent eligible environmental attributes and cannot be assumed to equal all local renewable output.
Renewable eligibility is technology- and condition-specific; not every carbon-free source qualifies.
The 2030 renewable fraction is a retail-sales policy obligation, not a local generation target.
Distribution cooperatives and generation/transmission cooperatives are distinct categories.
Cooperative RPS compliance requires certificate retirement evidence.
2030 50% target applies to the distribution cooperative retail sales context.
Generation/transmission cooperative has member supply obligations distinct from direct retail sales.
Inflation-adjusted cost threshold and its limits cannot be omitted from compliance interpretation.
